lines.text: Paul says elders who lead well deserve double honor, and he quotes Scripture about not muzzling an ox treading grain.
Paul tells Timothy to accept an accusation against an elder only on the testimony of two or three elders.
Paul charges Timothy before God, Christ Jesus and the elect angels to act without partiality and not be quick with laying on of hands.
Paul tells Timothy to use a little wine because of his stomach and frequent ailments, and says good deeds cannot stay hidden.
Paul says slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters less because they are neighbors.

wrong_details.wrong: serve believing masters less because they are neighbors
wrong_details.true: serve them all the more because they are brothers
